name: Fancy Grilled Cheese Sandwiches on Flaxseed Bread
description:
These sophisticated grilled cheese sandwiches come together quickly. They are also keto-friendly.
Serves 4 as an appetizer

ingredients.item: of brie or camembert, sliced thin
ingredients.text: 1 package of brie or camembert, sliced thin

ingredients.item: full-fat mayo, such as Gefen Mayonnaise
ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons full-fat mayo, such as Gefen Mayonnaise

direction_groups.title: Prepare the Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
steps: Spread mayonnaise on all the slices of bread.
In a heavy-bottomed pan lay four slices of bread, mayonnaise side down.
Set heat to medium and cover each bread with one layer of brie slices. Cover the bread with the rest of slices - mayonnaise side up.
When cheese begins to melt, flip each sandwich until they are toasted on both sides.
